description: Solution and dilution calculator — Lab prep math: give formula (or molar_mass) plus two of mass_g, volume_ml, molarity and get the third, with moles, % w/v, g/L and prep instructions (hydrates supported, e.g. CuSO4.5H2O). Or mode=dilution with any three of c1, v1, c2, v2 (C1V1 = C2V2). Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
